sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Hand-painted outlined 2D platformer enemy animation sprite sheet. Reference image is ONLY character identity/style, not pose count/layout. Exactly SIX full-body poses in a precise equal 3-column by 2-row grid on 1536x1024 canvas; 512x512 cells. Chronological reading order. Same camera, scale and identity in every cell, right-facing three-quarter. Subject total height approx 330px, 70px CLEAR transparent padding. Whole cap/body/arms/feet/effects inside each own cell with no overlap. Opaque subject interior, genuine transparent background, no floor, shadow, colored haze, text, labels, borders, scenery or other creatures. Do not copy reference layout. Same Sporeling red spotted cap, ivory/moss small root body. Six nonviolent defeat phases: weak upright; cap droops eyes closed; tiny root knees buckle; body gently collapses on its side; cap dims and body withers slightly; final resting collapsed mushroom with eyes closed. Clear progression from upright to fully down. No gore, no severed parts, no skull. First pose tall, second lower, third kneeling, fourth lying SIDEWAYS, fifth lower and duller, sixth fully down. Do not repeat upright poses. No ambient aura.
